description: The relay's pending list (spec/command-metadata.md, "The pending list"). Each case is a relay's Pending answer for a call to `command` from a client without URL-mode elicitation, and the whole error the server answers with. Every implementation that implements HumanRelay's pendingList answers each `pending` case with exactly `error`, and each `invalid` case with an internal error (no CommandError reaches the client). A language in `gaps` does not implement pendingList yet; its vector suite asserts the gap and skips the cases.

gaps.cpp: not applicable: afd::mcp_stdio has no HumanRelay

pending.name: a decision, its page and the list

error.message: 'memory-erase' needs a person's confirmation through the host
error.suggestion: Ask the person to open their pending decisions at https://person.example.com/d/ (or this one at https://person.example.com/d/d-1), check that it is decision d-1 for 'memory-erase', and decide there; then send this same call again.

invalid.name: a decision id that carries a sentence
